title: Gera
summary: Grain. (1.) The son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:3, 5, 7).

inlines.v: Grain. (1.) The son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin (1 Chr. 8:3, 5, 7).
(2.) The father of Ehud the judge (Judg. 3:15).
(3.) The father of Shimei, who so grossly abused David (2 Sam. 16:5; 19:16, 18).
